title: ToxVis: Enabling Interpretability of Implicit vs. Explicit Toxicity Detection Models with Interactive Visualization

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the performance of fine-tuned transformer models (BERT, RoBERTa, XLNet, GPT-3) in classifying text into explicit hate, implicit hate (including microaggressions), and non-hate categories using standard classification metrics like F1-score, Precision, Recall, and Accuracy.
